title: 家庭生活
description: 與家人互動及家庭相關話題

sentences.en: I have a big family.
sentences.zh: 我有一個大家庭。

sentences.en: My parents live in the countryside.
sentences.zh: 我父母住在鄉下。

sentences.en: I'm very close to my siblings.
sentences.zh: 我和兄弟姊妹感情很好。

sentences.en: We have dinner together every Sunday.
sentences.zh: 我們每週日一起吃晚餐。

sentences.en: My mom is an excellent cook.
sentences.zh: 我媽媽是個很棒的廚師。

sentences.en: My dad likes to go fishing on weekends.
sentences.zh: 我爸爸週末喜歡去釣魚。

sentences.en: My younger brother is still in college.
sentences.zh: 我弟弟還在念大學。

sentences.en: We often go on family trips during holidays.
sentences.zh: 我們假日常去家庭旅遊。

sentences.en: My grandparents are in good health.
sentences.zh: 我祖父母身體很健康。

sentences.en: I call my parents every week.
sentences.zh: 我每週打電話給爸媽。

sentences.en: My sister just had a baby.
sentences.zh: 我姊姊剛生了寶寶。

sentences.en: We celebrate birthdays together as a family.
sentences.zh: 我們全家一起慶祝生日。

sentences.en: My kids are growing up so fast.
sentences.zh: 我的小孩長得好快。

sentences.en: I help my children with their homework.
sentences.zh: 我幫孩子們做功課。

sentences.en: My husband does most of the cooking.
sentences.zh: 我先生負責大部分的做菜工作。

sentences.en: We take turns doing the housework.
sentences.zh: 我們輪流做家事。

sentences.en: My daughter is in elementary school.
sentences.zh: 我女兒在念小學。

sentences.en: We like to play board games together.
sentences.zh: 我們喜歡一起玩桌遊。

sentences.en: My family means everything to me.
sentences.zh: 家人對我來說就是一切。

sentences.en: We moved to a bigger house last year.
sentences.zh: 我們去年搬到了更大的房子。

sentences.en: I visit my parents every other weekend.
sentences.zh: 我每隔一個週末去看爸媽。

sentences.en: My son loves playing soccer.
sentences.zh: 我兒子很喜歡踢足球。

sentences.en: We adopted a cat from the shelter.
sentences.zh: 我們從收容所領養了一隻貓。

sentences.en: Family gatherings are always fun.
sentences.zh: 家庭聚會總是很開心。

sentences.en: My wife and I share household responsibilities.
sentences.zh: 我和太太共同分擔家務。

sentences.en: I read bedtime stories to my kids.
sentences.zh: 我會念睡前故事給小孩聽。

sentences.en: We're planning a family reunion next month.
sentences.zh: 我們下個月計畫辦家族聚會。

sentences.en: My older sister lives abroad.
sentences.zh: 我姊姊住在國外。

sentences.en: We video call our relatives during holidays.
sentences.zh: 我們過節時會和親戚視訊。

sentences.en: My family is my biggest support.
sentences.zh: 家人是我最大的支持。
